description: A categorical grader with MORE THAN TWO categories (e.g. correct / incorrect / invalid, or reference / candidate / equal / invalid) must map its non-pass/non-fail 'could not judge' category to score: null, passed: false -- the same rule as an unparseable llm_judge output, but reached from a different native shape (a closed category enum rather than free text). Folding the 'invalid' category into the failure bucket silently overcounts a categorical grader's failure rate by conflating 'confidently wrong' with 'couldn't judge at all'. Derived from a real case in arthur-bench-openeval-adapter: qa_correctness returns incorrect/correct/invalid, and summary_quality returns reference/candidate/equal/invalid -- both adapters map their 'invalid' category to this exact shape.
